title: Position methods past the trained length
summary: Which position schemes carry relative position, and which ones extend.

choices.text: Position interpolation scales the position index so a longer prompt lands inside the original trained range. YaRN goes further: it interpolates low-frequency RoPE dimensions more than high-frequency ones, and it applies a temperature to the attention logits.
A learned absolute position table is applied inside the softmax, so any length longer than the table works with no new parameters.
RoPE rotates pairs of query and key coordinates by an angle that depends on the token position, so the query-key dot product depends on the relative offset.
ALiBi adds a head-specific linear penalty on the distance between the two tokens to the attention scores, and does not add a position vector to the token embeddings.
